objective: Add a read-only evidence packet and evidence search for the lead
criteria: AC1: `evidence` returns risk signals for the current round (acceptance failure, skipped/unquiet/tree-changing runs, truncated output, environment failures, worker-reported failures and open items, changed-file mismatches, acceptance test changes, controller errors, verdict splits and single-reviewer blocking findings), each with the raw artifact name and SHA-256; per-code caps become explicit omitted counts with source pointers

AC2: `evidence-search` runs an in-memory BM25 search over controller-written evidence on every call, with redaction, byte budgets, whole-hit omission and symlink/size limits; dispatch prompts and state are excluded
AC3: `compare-repeated` reports optional `buried_defect_detected` per arm without changing guardrail completeness or reduction figures
AC4: both commands use the inspection path: no lock, state change, writes, model launch or code execution, and neither participates in approval

objective: Route controller decisions through lead-family roles instead of hard-coded Sol, Sonnet and Haiku
criteria: AC1: a new team-roles module derives the APEX member, the specialist, grant-only members, reserved members and delegable owners from the lead model
AC2: an Opus lead keeps the previous member names and every existing test passes unchanged
AC3: non-Claude leads review under family-rules-v1 with the team recorded in the assignment and must use lead-gated-adaptive review
AC4: strategy names and state records are unchanged; the lead is still the configured Opus

objective: Let the host decide the lead model and lock its family for the task
criteria: AC1: a lead-host module resolves the lead model from host hooks, then the operator's HF_LEAD_MODEL, then the configured Opus, and refuses conflicting families; a repository config can only keep lead:'opus'
AC2: the lead identity and grade are fixed at init and begin refuses a lead family change
AC3: non-Claude leads stay at grade C until their host is verified, which turns off delegation and takeover
AC4: Claude Code guard hooks block on failure, PreModelSwitch refuses cross-family switches during a task, and the Bash guard refuses lead-set HF_ALLOW_*/HF_LEAD_* relaxations
AC5: project plans check non-Claude teams by family rules

objective: Add a model registry and a family-based team composer as groundwork for host-agnostic leads
criteria: AC1: a model registry maps models to the company family that made them; unknown models never count as independent of any other model
AC2: a team composer refuses a team with fewer than two families
AC3: the family-rules-v1 plan reproduces the cross-vendor-pairs-v1 reviewers and efforts for an Opus lead
AC4: legacy-v1 differs for Luna, Haiku and Sonnet when only AGY is present, so existing policies stay in review-plan.mjs; the new modules are not wired into the controller yet

objective: Add a read-only round-diff for re-review after REDO
criteria: AC1: from round 2, begin stores the content of files that already differ from HEAD (text only, bounded) as round-base-N.json
AC2: a read-only round-diff command diffs that base against the current tree so the lead sees only what the redo round changed
AC3: missing or mismatched bases are reported instead of guessed
AC4: the round-diff output is not authoritative and approval still covers the cumulative diff
